title: ioBroker State Change Numeric Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=iobroker:state numeric_value=*
| stats sum(numeric_value) as total_value, avg(numeric_value) as avg_value by object_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks object values by total and average numeric value across ioBroker state change events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `numeric_value` values for each ioBroker state change event and review total and average numeric value by object.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total numeric value.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly which object shows the biggest numeric value numbers in your ioBroker state change data.
